1.name: Water outlet housing
1.note: The cast housing the thermostat sits in. It guides coolant either to the radiator or round the bypass back to the pump.

2.name: Thermostat cover
2.note: Closes the housing and carries the spigot for the radiator hose.

3.name: Flange seal
3.note: Seals the cover to the housing, so coolant reaches the radiator only through the valve.

4.name: Hex bolt
4.note: Clamps the cover and the thermostat flange to the housing.

5.name: Washer
5.note: Spreads the bolt load over the cover.

6.name: Flange and seat
6.note: The frame of the thermostat. It carries the bridge and gives the main valve disc its seat.

7.name: Bridge
7.note: The fixed cross-piece the pin pushes against. It is the fixed end of the actuator, so the cup moves down instead.

8.name: Pin
8.note: Pushed out of the sleeve by the expanding wax. Its stroke is the wax's volume gain divided by the pin's area.

9.name: Sleeve (sock diaphragm)
9.note: A rubber sock that transmits the wax's pressure to the pin and keeps the wax from leaking out.

10.name: Pellet cup
10.note: The brass cup holding the wax. It conducts the coolant's heat in, and it is the part that moves down to open the valve.

11.name: Wax charge
11.note: The sensor and actuator in one. It melts across a range, swells by 12 %, and this is the setpoint; the copper powder improves heat flow.

12.name: Piston guide
12.note: Guides the pin and sleeve at the top of the cup, so the wax pushes the cup straight along the pin.

13.name: Valve disc
13.note: The main valve, carried on the pellet. As the cup moves down it leaves its seat and opens the route to the radiator.

14.name: Main spring
14.note: Pushes the cup back up and the valve shut. The wax must overcome its preload before the valve opens, and its rate adds the droop above the setpoint.

15.name: Spring stirrup
15.note: The fixed legs of the frame. They reach down from the flange and seat the lower end of the main spring.

16.name: Bypass stem
16.note: Hangs below the cup and carries the bypass disc, so it moves with the valve.

17.name: Bypass disc
17.note: Shuts the bypass as the main valve opens, so the coolant is sent to the radiator rather than round the engine.

18.name: Bypass spring
18.note: Holds the bypass disc on its stem and returns it when the thermostat closes.

19.name: Jiggle pin
19.note: A loose pin in a small hole in the flange. Even when closed it leaves a gap for air and a little coolant, so air can bleed out of the system.

20.name: Coolant temperature sensor
20.note: Reads the coolant temperature for the engine controller. It is not part of the wax loop.

21.name: Sealing ring
21.note: Seals the sensor in the housing.

22.name: Radiator hose
22.note: Carries the hot coolant on to the radiator once the thermostat has opened.

23.name: Hose clip
23.note: Clamps the radiator hose onto the cover spigot.

24.name: Back-up ring
24.note: A PTFE ring round the pin below the guide, supporting the sleeve against the pressure of the wax.
